scope: Independent postrun verification of the paired p20183 rank-5 phi7 SIMD numerator, lane, input words, and stored AL address for B1 and DM065.
decision: The raw streams support the bounded machine-arithmetic observation for one target lane in phi call seven per arm. This is mechanism evidence only; no alternate grouping or forecast effect was evaluated.
checks: The final design review hash is bound by the run freeze; all 28 frozen inputs match the worktree and executable hashes at review time.
Paired exit file reports B1=0 and DM065=0. Archived receipts, gzip artifacts, and decompressed bytes match the paired closure hashes and the live raw streams byte-for-byte.
Each raw numerator stream has contiguous event sequence and one phi7 entry, one earlier-PH read watch, one matching prepoint, twelve ordered instruction stops, and a captured phi return.

Both arms report target p20183 at (144,142,4), caller 0x13eb579, completed KDM count 1, hypsometric option 2, use_theta_m 1, and the recorded raw nonhydrostatic LOGICAL word. The phi7 inputs equal both the frozen plan and seventh companion phi entry.
Reconstructed target AL, PH(k), PH(k+1), PHB(k), PHB(k+1), and neighbor PH(k−1) addresses from the raw bases and bounds. Target store, lane mapping, and read-watch address agree.

Re-decoded the selected lane from every raw XMM snapshot and independently recomputed all three numerator operations, both divisions, and final AL using binary32 rounding. The final word equals the post-store target memory word and phi7 returned AL.
Each arm staged input map equals the case receipt, all 89 source files still match their recorded hashes, and h00 SHA equals its frozen phase0 parity receipt.

Independently decoded phase0 selected-target binary captures and compared all eight target KDM ENTRY/RETURN records (four per stage per arm) with the companion phi trace; every 16-field record matched exactly.

observed.instruction_expression: (PH(k+1) - PH(k)) + PHB(k+1) - PHB(k), in the observed SIMD instruction order

limitations: One selected lane in one phi call per arm; lane 2 means the third float of the observed four-lane vector.
No alternate grouping was run; this does not show whether another grouping would improve the model or forecast.
No causal attribution from the numerator difference to forecast skill, and no physics policy change is justified by this capture alone.
Full four-step KDM parity is recorded by the runner and its raw companion capture; this independent review focused on numerator and AL binding.
